name: Debug Settings
note: Unlock debug tab in settings menu

name: Quick Store Rotation
note: One-minute shop rotation override, offers last six minutes. Shop data stored in /data/gt7offline/shop_catalog_1710.json

name: Wheel Offset Presets
note: Shows the native Wide wheel offsets and adds ten 5 mm wider pairs.

name: Live Settings
note: Enable the live settings bridge to enable in-game credit editor. Select credits icon to open

name: New Game Intro Movie Skip
note: Press ○ to skip the 6+ minute opening movie. Patch not required after save file is created

name: Debug Environment
note: Changes the internal build environment to expose additional demo, LAN, B-Spec, and car settings.
